question: For any complex number \(z=x+iy\) with \(x,y\) real, define \(\langle z\rangle=|x|+|y|\). Let \(z_1,z_2\) be any two complex numbers. Then

options.A: \(\langle z_1+z_2angle<\langle z_1angle+\langle z_2angle\)
options.B: \(\langle z_1+z_2angle\le\langle z_1angle+\langle z_2angle\)
options.C: \(\langle z_1+z_2angle\ge\langle z_1angle+\langle z_2angle\)
options.D: none of the foregoing statements need always be true
